cases.prompt: Write an English incident update of at most 80 words using all and only these facts. Service Orion was rolled back from version 2.4 to version 2.3 at 07:05 UTC. The error rate fell from 1.6% to 0.8%. Monitoring is still ongoing. Resolution has not been confirmed. Do not call the incident resolved or invent a cause, date or next update time.
cases.forbidden: Reversed version/rate direction; resolved incident; invented cause/date/update time.

cases.prompt: Rédige un message en français de 80 mots maximum en conservant tous les faits suivants, sans en inventer. La facture F-218 de Léa est de 240 EUR. Un paiement de 90 EUR a été reçu. Le solde restant est de 150 EUR, à régler avant le 14 octobre. Aucun rappel n'a encore été envoyé. Ne dis pas que la facture est entièrement payée et n'ajoute pas de pénalité.
facts: invoice F-218 for Léa totals 240 EUR
cases.forbidden: Fully paid invoice; reminder already sent; invented penalty or year.

cases.prompt: Escribe una actualización en español de no más de 80 palabras con todos estos hechos y sin añadir otros. El pedido AX-17 contiene 6 teclados. La salida está prevista para el viernes, pero todavía no se ha enviado. No hay número de seguimiento disponible. La entrega aún no tiene fecha confirmada. No inventes una hora, empresa de transporte ni fecha de entrega.
cases.forbidden: Already dispatched/delivered; tracking number; invented carrier/time/delivery date.

cases.prompt: 请用中文写一段不超过180个字符的会议通知，保留以下全部事实，不添加新事实：会议暂定10月6日14:30在B12会议室举行。周宁负责确认场地，尚未确认。陈雨将准备议程，但尚未完成。只有场地确认后才能发送正式邀请。不要把暂定安排说成已确认，也不要添加年份。
facts: meeting tentative October 6 at 14:30 in room B12
周宁 must confirm venue; not confirmed
陈雨 will prepare agenda; not complete
formal invitation only after venue confirmation
cases.forbidden: Swapped responsibilities; completed agenda; confirmed venue/meeting; invented year.

cases.prompt: Schreibe auf Deutsch eine Kundendienstnachricht mit höchstens 80 Wörtern. Verwende alle folgenden Fakten und erfinde keine weiteren: Die Bestellung R-52 betrifft 49 EUR. Der Erstattungsantrag von Nora ist eingegangen, wurde aber noch nicht genehmigt. Die Prüfung kann bis zu 7 Werktage dauern. Eine Auszahlung wurde noch nicht veranlasst. Versprich kein festes Auszahlungsdatum.
facts: review may take up to 7 business days
cases.forbidden: Approved/refunded/completed payment; calendar rather than business days; guaranteed payout date.

cases.prompt: 次の事実をすべて保ち、220文字以内の日本語で保守のお知らせを書いてください。保守は10月8日13:00から13:20まで東京時間で予定されています。サービス名はKumoです。バックアップは作成済みですが、復元テストはまだ実施していません。予定は変更される可能性があります。年や追加の作業内容を作らず、復元テストが成功したとは書かないでください。
facts: Kumo maintenance planned October 8, 13:00-13:20 Tokyo time
cases.forbidden: Completed/successful restore test; certain schedule; invented year/work.

cases.prompt: Write English release notes of at most 80 words using every fact below and no extra feature claims. Version 1.8 adds dark mode and CSV export. PDF export is not available. A known keyboard-navigation issue remains in the settings dialog. Existing saved projects are retained. Do not describe the release as fully accessible or claim the keyboard issue is fixed.
facts: keyboard-navigation issue remains in settings dialog
cases.forbidden: PDF support; keyboard fix; fully accessible; lost projects; extra features.

cases.prompt: Escreva em português um resumo de inventário com no máximo 80 palavras, mantendo todos os fatos e sem criar outros. O depósito tinha 10 unidades do item L-9, recebeu 6 e enviou 4. Agora há 12 unidades no depósito, das quais 3 estão reservadas e 9 estão disponíveis para novos pedidos. As unidades reservadas ainda não foram enviadas. Não trate as reservas como vendas já despachadas.
cases.forbidden: Wrong arithmetic or stock status; reserved units already shipped; invented customer/price.

cases.prompt: Explain this fictional validation rule in English in at most 80 words, preserving every detail. A request is accepted only if retries is an integer from 0 through 3 inclusive and dry_run is true. A request with retries=3 and dry_run=true is accepted. A request with retries=4 and dry_run=true is rejected. A request with retries=0 and dry_run=false is rejected. Do not reverse any result or infer what processing happens after acceptance.
facts: integer retries in inclusive range 0-3 AND dry_run true
cases.forbidden: OR instead of AND; changed boundary/results; fractional retries allowed; invented downstream processing.

cases.prompt: Écris en français une comparaison de 80 mots maximum qui conserve tous les faits suivants sans conclusion supplémentaire. Le forfait A coûte 12 EUR par mois et inclut 5 Go. Le forfait B coûte 18 EUR par mois et inclut 20 Go. Aucun des deux ne comprend l'assistance téléphonique. Le forfait B n'est pas moins cher que le forfait A. Ne recommande pas un forfait et ne présente pas le stockage comme illimité.
facts: B is not cheaper than A
cases.forbidden: Swapped prices/storage; unlimited storage; telephone support; recommendation.

cases.prompt: Redacta un correo en español de hasta 80 palabras con todos estos hechos, sin añadir otros. Lucía puede revisar el borrador del informe, pero no puede publicarlo. Solo Omar puede autorizar su publicación. La falta de respuesta de Omar no cuenta como autorización. Si no hay autorización explícita, el informe debe permanecer privado. No inventes que alguien ya lo ha revisado o aprobado.
facts: Lucía may review draft but may not publish
without explicit authorization report remains private
cases.forbidden: Swapped actors; implied consent; approved/reviewed already; publication without authorization.

cases.prompt: Write an English handoff note of at most 80 words using all and only these facts. Imani owns the database migration. Theo owns the documentation update. The migration is blocked until backup verification finishes. Documentation work may continue meanwhile. Verification is pending; neither migration completion nor deployment is confirmed. Do not swap owners or say all work must stop.
facts: migration blocked until backup verification finishes
cases.forbidden: Swapped owners; all work stopped; verified backup; completed migration/deployment.

engine_integrity.scope: Namespaced derivative integrity; no detector or scientific acceptance verdict.

key_policy: All four existing keys, including known failure; no selection or rotation
failure_policy: 96 attempts, no retries/replacement/rewriting; retain errors and caps
review: Freeze per-fact and forbidden-addition content ratings, language ratings and mechanical format results before revealing conditions/keys/scores. Assistant review; not independent human acceptance.
primary: Separate content, language, format and execution failures; per-task/paired/key counts. Descriptive new-task generalization, not a powered noninferiority or causal study.
detector: Unchanged weighted 30-layer tail <= .005 per key for matching/next-slot keys; nominal two-key 1%, uncalibrated. Short outputs may not carry enough signal.
scope: Twelve fresh synthetic source-grounded tasks, seven languages, one Qwen/MLX model and four reused keys. No open-domain factual, framework, scientific or launch acceptance.
